report.summary: Push campaign sent to 2.1M users at 13:30 triggered a massive traffic surge that overwhelmed orders-service, exhausting its executor queue and causing error rates to spike.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Traffic surge triggered by diwali_sip_offer push campaign overwhelming orders-service capacity

supporting.note: Push campaign sent at 13:30 to 2.1M users with deep link orders/new-sip.
mobile-bff traffic jumped immediately after campaign.
orders-service traffic spiked from ~120 req/s to over 800 req/s.
Error rate spiked to over 14% at 13:32.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Downstream broker-api slowness blocking order threads

contradicting.note: Queue full errors point to incoming request volume rather than waiting on downstream connections.

facts.text: Push campaign 'diwali_sip_offer' was sent to 2.1M users at 2026-10-10T13:30:00+00:00.
mobile-bff and orders-service request rates spiked starting at 2026-10-10T13:31:00+00:00.
orders-service and mobile-bff error rates began increasing at 2026-10-10T13:32:00+00:00.
orders-service logged RejectedExecutionException due to order-executor queue full capacity starting at 2026-10-10T13:32:04+00:00.

assumptions: The push campaign deep link directed users directly to create new SIPs, causing simultaneous submission spikes.
The default thread pool and queue limits on orders-service are insufficient for multi-million user campaign bursts.
evidence_gaps: Metrics for orders-service initially timed out and required log/dependent metric correlation.
External vendor metrics for broker-api are limited.

timeline.event: mobile-bff and orders-service traffic (RPS) begins spiking
Error rates and latencies start rising on orders-service and mobile-bff

recommended_actions.action: Increase horizontal autoscaling limits (max replicas) for orders-service
recommended_actions.rationale: Service reached max replicas and saturated CPU during the campaign surge.

recommended_actions.action: Tune and increase order-executor queue and thread pool capacity
recommended_actions.rationale: Queue capacity 500 was fully exhausted causing rejections.

recommended_actions.action: Implement rate limiting and staggered push notifications for marketing campaigns
recommended_actions.rationale: Broadcasting to 2.1M users simultaneously causes unsustainable traffic spikes.
